newsitem.title: CANADA: Santa Cruz starts prefeasibility study.
newsitem.headline: Santa Cruz starts prefeasibility study.

text.p: Santa Cruz Gold Inc said on Wednesday that it started a prefeasibility study on its Magistral gold project in Sinaloa, Mexico.
The study would focus on the San Rafael deposit, one of three known deposits on the Magistral property, Santa Cruz said.

A study a year ago showed the Magistral project hosted inferred resources of 28 million tonnes grading 1.5 grams of gold a tonne or 1.35 million ounces of gold. A recent independent ore reserve study of San Rafael deposit showed that it hosted reserves of six million tonnes grading 1.59 grams of gold a tonne or 309,800 ounces of gold, which included 480,000 tonnes of higher grade tailings.
